notes.title: Hello everyone, my new game INSIGHT will be released soon
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1602980/INSIGHT/
[b]Add the game to the wishlist[/b] if you are interested. Thank you for your support~ 
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1602980/extras/1.gif?t=1632751227
Thank you for your support, the new game is a puzzle game.
This is a game that uses lines to cut shapes. You need to split a large figure into several identical small figures. The inspiration for the game comes from the Witness and Understand.

notes.title: Survival mode changes
notes.content:
The flow experience of survival mode is not very strong. Some adjustments are currently made:
1. It is more difficult to recharge the survival mode recovery button, and it is easier for players to make difficult choices in the early stage. This will increase the difficulty of survival mode.
2. Survival mode will also get points when charging, which will give you a lot of extra points, making the score on the new difficulty more consistent with the old difficulty.

notes.title: Rogue skill changes
notes.content:
Original skill: Remove a number
After modification: make a number become the sum of its own digits

Reason for modification: It is duplicated with bomb item.
